crossRefs.note: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News…
Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
They have made it a desolation. It mourns to me, being desolate. The whole land is made desolate, because no one cares.
A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t…
She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

translations.web: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
translations.bsb: We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time.
translations.kjv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
translations.asv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
